message.content:
Yes—if you’re experiencing excessive or disruptive noise in Atlanta, you can file a complaint with the city’s authorities. Here’s how it works: | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Contact | |------|------------|------------------------------| | **1. Identify the source** | Determine whether the noise is coming from a residential building, commercial property, construction site, or public event. | — | | **2. Check the noise ordinance** | Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance (Title 9, Chapter 5 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets limits on decibel levels and defines “noisy” activities. It also specifies quiet hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). | City of Atlanta Municipal Code – see the official website or the *Atlanta Municipal Code* PDF. | | **3. File a complaint** | • **Phone:** Call 311 (or 404‑727‑3111 if you’re outside the city) for non‑emergency reporting.
• **Online:** Use the City of Atlanta’s “Report a Problem” portal (https://www.atlantaga.gov/311).
• **In person:** Visit the City Hall or the local police precinct. | City of Atlanta Police Department – Non‑Emergency Line: 404‑727‑3111
City of Atlanta 311 portal | | **4. Provide details** | • Your name and address (optional but helpful).
• Date, time, and duration of the noise.
• Description of the activity (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).
• Any evidence (photos, audio recordings, witness statements). | — | | **5. Follow up** | After filing, the police will investigate. If the noise violates the ordinance, they may issue a warning or citation. | City of Atlanta Police Department | ### Quick Tips - **Quiet Hours:** Most residential areas enforce quiet hours from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m. If the noise occurs during these times, it’s more likely to be actionable. - **Construction:** If the noise is from a construction site, the contractor must have a valid permit. You can also check the permit status via the City’s Building & Development Services portal. - **Recurring Issues:** For repeated disturbances, consider filing a formal complaint and requesting a follow‑up inspection. ### Useful Links - **Atlanta Municipal Code – Noise Ordinance**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/municipal-code/noise-ordinance - **City of Atlanta 311 Portal**: https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 - **Atlanta Police Department – Non‑Emergency Line**: 404‑727‑3111 If you’re unsure whether your situation falls under the noise ordinance, you can always call 311 first; they’ll direct you to the appropriate department and explain the next steps.
